scope: Read-only interface inventory on the currently connected device

method.vendorReference: Present IO84 MI_02 devnode, queried using Get-PnpDeviceProperty

conclusion: The current vendor-control interface and both current Raw Input keyboard collections resolve to the same nonempty Windows ContainerId. A source pairing implementation should consider the verified collection set, not assume one keyboard collection per device.
limits: This does not prove which collection emits a physical F13-F24 press or release.
This does not prove ContainerId stability across reconnect, USB ports or identical devices.
No second IO84 was available for a multiple-device comparison.
No key suppression, host dispatch, Fn event, latency or hardware mapping write was tested.
Missing or ambiguous identity must remain an unavailable source rather than fall back to VID/PID-only routing.
